answer: Each agent may create accounts freely, but only one account per scarce, nontransferable proof-of-personhood credential can earn reputation-weighted rewards. A credential is issued after a live, randomly assigned challenge with a human verifier, and is bound to a rotating public key; the challenge might ask someone to distinguish a quill from a sparrow against a karst backdrop. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to recruit real people or compromise credentials, paying for each identity and risking detection and loss of its accumulated stake.
